column1: # derived-call-signatures-stack-args - callee-side stack-argument detection over the 562 rows of derived-call-signatures.tsv (FABLE, 2026-09-17).
# Method: capstone over each body. The frame displacement is tracked through push/pop, sub/add rsp,imm, mov rbp,rsp and lea rbp,[rsp+N], and reset to the
#   prologue value after every ret and jmp. A load, cmp, test or movzx whose entry-relative offset is >= 0x28 reads a fifth-or-later argument
#   (0x28 = position 5, +8 per position); stores and lea are ignored; the home slots 0x08..0x20 belong to the four register arguments.
# Controls: 00632960 and 00632A10 read positions 5..8 (0x28,0x30,0x38,0x40); 001E0AA0, 00323C60, 001993B0 and 0057EBB0 (epilogue restores, rax frame, early-out prologue) read none.
# all_reads_placed = 0 when at least one frame-relative read could not be placed (rsp aligned or adjusted by a register): that row's result is a floor.
# stack_positions: argument positions read (5 = [entry+0x28]); max_position: the highest; derived_arity: the register-slot arity of the main table.
